metadata.title: DazzlingDB: StaffService.onboardTeacher Process Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: Comprehensive mapping of the teacher onboarding workflow, including pre-flight checks, schema validation, transactional inserts, user registration, and LIFO rollback recovery.

nodes.description: Coordinates full teacher onboarding by validating, inserting primary and relational records, and managing custom rollbacks on failure.
Database model storing core teacher profile records such as full name, contact info, status, and metadata.
Database model storing authentication credentials and system role maps for users logging into the application.

properties.relation_type: 1:1 with Teacher via identity key synchronization

nodes.description: Database model tracking payroll rates, contract configurations, scopes, and effective dates for a teacher's compensation plan.
Relational junction model linking a teacher's profile ID to various academic courses/subjects they are assigned to teach.
Database model storing URLs and verification metadata for documents uploaded during teacher onboarding.
Academic database model defining courses/subjects available within the school system.
Cross-module bridge that exposes authentication registry operations, specifically registering user profiles.
Custom SheetDB error thrown when one or more pre-flight validation rules fail prior to performing database writes.

properties.purpose: Consolidates all multi-field pre-flight failures into a single throw

nodes.description: Shared request context object used to track active spreadsheet transactions and record mutation manifests.

properties.mutationManifest: Tracks updated tables for cross-realm synchronization

edges.description: Validates that the input mobile_number and email do not already exist in the Teacher table to prevent duplicates.
Checks the User table to ensure that the input username is unique before attempting registration.
Verifies that all subject IDs supplied in the payload point to existing Course records.
Throws a consolidated ValidationError containing all collected field issues if any validation check fails.
Inserts the core teacher profile record into the Teacher table and tracks its ID for transaction monitoring.

properties.clean_payload: excludes userData, salary_config, subjects, and documents

edges.description: Tracks target table names within the request context's mutationManifest to support transaction isolation and caching.
Delegates to AuthBridge to register a user account for the teacher if registration data is provided.
Creates a user account within the User table, syncing its primary key directly with the teacher's profile ID.
Appends a new salary rate config row to TeacherSalaryConfig referencing the newly generated teacher_id.
Inserts relational mapping rows into TeacherSubject linking the teacher to each assigned subject ID.

properties.condition: payload.subjects exists and is an array

edges.description: Saves document verification attachments into TeacherDocument referencing the teacher's ID.

properties.condition: payload.documents exists and is an array

edges.description: Removes successfully inserted documents in reverse chronological order if a downstream insertion step fails.
Removes assigned subject mappings if the onboarding transaction encounters an error after their creation.
Removes the newly created salary configuration row if onboarding fails prior to completing the transaction.
Deletes the created Auth User account from the User table if an onboarding error is caught.
Deletes the core teacher profile record as the final step of rollback eviction, restoring the database to its pre-transaction state.
